# PM011: cycle-without-goal

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| family | PM |
| product | frob |
| severity (default) | warn |
| tier | universal |
| scope | repo |
| fix | manual |
| polarity | P+ |
| must_measure | false |
| version | 1 |
| since | 2.0.0 |

An open or planned cycle states no goal.

A cycle without a goal cannot be judged at its review: the team has
nothing to say it achieved.

## Remedy

Give the cycle a goal: close and recreate it with `frob cycle new --goal
TEXT`.

## Examples

### PM011 cycle without a goal / An open cycle with no goal fires #1 (line 8) (fire)

```text
cycle c start=-1 end=5 goal=none
```

### PM011 cycle without a goal / A planned cycle with no goal fires #2 (line 14) (fire)

```text
cycle c start=3 end=10 goal=none
```

### PM011 cycle without a goal / A cycle with a goal is clean #3 (line 20) (clean)

```text
cycle c start=-1 end=5
```

### PM011 cycle without a goal / A closed cycle with no goal is not judged #4 (line 26) (clean)

```text
cycle c start=-10 end=-5 goal=none closed
```
